claim.quote: assuming standard xenon quenching factor (qXe) of 0.19, our ZEPLIN-II limits strongly suggest the exclusion of iDM signal claims at >99% C.L., for Weakly Interacting Massive Particles (WIMPs) masses >100 GeV.

name: Constraints on Inelastic Dark Matter Signal using ZEPLIN-II Results

summary.plain: ZEPLIN-II's data were used to test the idea that inelastic dark matter could explain the DAMA signal, and ruled it out for heavy particles.
summary.technical: Constraints on inelastic dark matter (iDM) from ZEPLIN-II results, using previously published estimates of the residual background; excludes iDM signal claims at >99% C.L. for WIMP masses >100 GeV assuming a xenon quenching factor of 0.19.

title: Constraints on Inelastic Dark Matter Signal using ZEPLIN-II Results
why_it_matters: A re-interpretation of the ZEPLIN-II first run, relevant to the DAMA signal.
